name: Camera Stabilized
description: Has an infrared mode, variable field of view, stabilized and tracking modes.
shortDescription: A stabilized gimbal camera with video output feed.

logicNodes.label: Infrared Mode
logicNodes.description: Controls whether or not the infrared mode is switched on.

logicNodes.label: Stabilizer Mode
logicNodes.description: Enable stabilization to keep the camera focused in its current direction.

logicNodes.label: Tracker Mode
logicNodes.description: Enable tracking to direct the camera at the current lazed position.

logicNodes.label: Field of View
logicNodes.description: Controls the level of zoom of the camera.

logicNodes.label: Pivot Rotation
logicNodes.description: Controls the rotation of the camera base.

logicNodes.label: Pitch Rotation
logicNodes.description: Controls the rotation of the camera head.

logicNodes.label: Laser Wavelength
logicNodes.description: The specific light wavelength to emit (whole number).

logicNodes.label: Composite Output
logicNodes.description: Composite value channels: 1: x position of laser target, 2: y position of laser target, 3: z position of laser target, 4: pitch of component in turns, 5: yaw of component in turns
